options.name: Sweep reversion
options.description: Fades a failed run past a liquidity level, back toward the middle of the range. Trades ranging conditions that the SMC mode rejects outright, so it fires far more often for a smaller target.
options.expectedFrequency: several a day across a wide symbol list
options.thesis: price that cannot hold beyond a swept level returns into its range

options.name: Smart Money Concepts
options.description: Trades continuation after a structural shift: a liquidity sweep, a break of structure with displacement, and an entry back inside the imbalance it left. Requires H4, H1 and M15 to agree, so it stands aside often and aims far.
options.thesis: structure breaks in the direction institutional flow has already committed to
